{{Quote|So you want to know about how starships work, huh? Well you came to the right place. I can tear apart a hyperdrive super-conductor coil blindfolded and can calibrate your engine displacement ration with a rabid bantha tied to my feet. If you're going to fly around the galaxy, you ''have'' to know how things work on a starship&hellip; and why. Otherwise, you're vapebait for the first pirate that decides you're easy prey.|"Slide" Brombek|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
'''"Slide" Brombek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]]. They had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], light skin, dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a purple [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of abstract design on their right hand. The Human wore a cream-colored [[Clothing/Legends|undershirt]], a brown tunic over it, brown pants, brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with many pouches.<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition" />

At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an individual came to Brombek wanting to learn how [[Starship/Legends|starships]] worked. The outlaw tech told the individual they came to the right place and claimed that they could tear apart a [[Hyperdrive superconductor coil|hyperdrive superconducter coil]] while blindfolded, and that they could calibrate an [[engine displacement ratio]] with a rabid [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] tied to their feet. Brombek then told the individual they would be easy prey for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] without knowing how things work on a starship. After the outlaw tech was transmitted [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to an account the two had previously discussed, Brombek told them to grab a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]] before the pair got to work.<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Slide" Brombek was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a [[1997]] supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition" />
